Strategy: Reward residuals between thirty and forty-five while penalizing residuals between eight and twenty-two, steering bins toward reusable middle leftovers and away from awkward small gaps. This combination beat Best Fit on another seed, but the same limits may not transfer and the penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
